versions.changelog: Reduce gateway scope from operator.admin to operator.write (least privilege)
Default to Matilda voice (free tier); recommend Ivy for paid. Free tier now supported.
Improved description with implementation details and recommended voice
Fix metadata: declare GATEWAY_TOKEN and GATEWAY_URL in requires.env, fix python3 -> python for Windows

Initial release of OpenClaw Voice Assistant.

- Enables always-on, hands-free voice control for OpenClaw on Windows PCs.
- Features wake word detection (Porcupine), fast speech-to-text (faster-whisper), and natural text-to-speech (ElevenLabs).
- Flexible configuration with .env for API keys, models, hotkeys, and tuning.
- Custom wake word support and personalized chime/thinking sounds.
- System tray app with background mode and Windows auto-start instructions.
- Comprehensive troubleshooting and architecture documentation included.
